Job Description – CNC Operator

Company: Senwell Exports Pvt. Ltd.
Industry: Precision Engineering – Aerospace, Defence & Oil & Gas Components
Location: Kesnand–Wagholi, Pune
Position: CNC Operator
Experience: 2–3 Years
Shift: Rotational / 3 Shifts

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled CNC Operator with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in CNC machining. The candidate will be responsible for operating CNC machines, maintaining quality standards, achieving production targets, and following safety and process requirements.

Key Responsibilities
• Operate CNC machines as per production plans, drawings and work instructions.
• Read and understand engineering drawings, dimensions and tolerances.
• Perform machine setting, tool offset correction and basic parameter adjustments.
• Load/unload components and ensure proper clamping and work holding.
• Use measuring instruments such as Vernier, Micrometer, Bore Gauge and Height Gauge.
• Inspect components during production and maintain required dimensional accuracy.
• Identify tool wear, machine abnormalities and quality issues and report them to the supervisor.
• Maintain production records, inspection records and shift-wise documentation.
• Follow 5S, safety procedures, quality standards and work instructions.
• Minimize rejection, rework, machine downtime and material wastage.
• Coordinate with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams for smooth production.
• Maintain cleanliness and basic housekeeping around the machine.

Required Skills
• 2–3 years of relevant CNC machine operating experience.
• Knowledge of CNC turning/machining operations.
• Basic knowledge of G-code/M-code and CNC programs.
• Ability to read engineering drawings.
• Knowledge of GD&T and dimensional inspection will be preferred.
• Hands-on experience with measuring instruments.
• Knowledge of cutting tools, tool offsets and tool wear.
• Ability to work in rotational shifts.
• Good discipline, attendance and willingness to learn.

Qualification

ITI / Diploma – Mechanical / Production / Machining / related technical trade.

Preferred Experience

Experience in precision engineering, aerospace, defence, automotive, Oil & Gas or similar manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Key Performance Areas
• Production target achievement
• Quality and dimensional accuracy
• Reduction of rejection and rework
• Machine utilization
• Tool management
• Safety and 5S compliance
• Attendance and shift discipline

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:
• Flexible schedule
• Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Job Summary

Education & Experience Qualifications

Job Requirements

Behavioral Competencies

• Regular punctual and good behavior.

Technical Competencies

• CAM knowledge for programming preferred

job_description:
Laser Cutting & CNC Bending Machine Operator – Sheet Metal Works

Department: Production / Sheet Metal Fabrication
Position: Laser Cutting & CNC Bending Machine Operator
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 2–5 Years
Location: Pune, Maharashtra
Reporting To: Production Manager / Fabrication Supervisor

1. Job Summary

The Laser Cutting & CNC Bending Machine Operator will be responsible for operating CNC laser cutting and CNC press brake bending machines for sheet-metal fabrication. The operator will ensure accurate cutting, bending, dimensional accuracy and quality of fabricated components as per approved drawings and production requirements.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. CNC Laser Cutting Machine
• Operate CNC fiber laser cutting machine for sheet-metal components.
• Read and understand engineering drawings, fabrication drawings and cutting layouts.
• Load and unload sheet-metal materials safely.
• Verify material grade, thickness and dimensions before processing.
• Load appropriate cutting programs and verify program parameters.
• Set cutting parameters such as power, speed, gas pressure and focus as per material and thickness.
• Monitor the machine during operation and identify cutting abnormalities.
• Inspect cut components for dimensional accuracy, edge quality, burrs and defects.
• Perform basic nozzle, lens and machine cleaning/maintenance as required.
• Minimize material wastage through proper nesting and sheet utilization.
• Report machine breakdowns, alarms and technical problems to the supervisor.

B. CNC Press Brake / Bending Machine
• Operate CNC press brake bending machines for sheet-metal components.
• Read and understand bending drawings and flat-pattern drawings.
• Select and install appropriate punches and dies.
• Set bending parameters, back gauge and bending sequence.
• Set bend angle, bend allowance and other required parameters.
• Perform trial bending and verify dimensions before batch production.
• Ensure correct bend angle, dimensions and orientation of components.
• Carry out multi-bend components accurately as per drawings.
• Monitor tool condition and report damaged or worn-out tooling.
• Ensure proper handling and stacking of finished components.

3. Quality Control
• Check dimensions using measuring instruments such as:
• Vernier caliper
• Measuring tape
• Micrometer
• Angle gauge / protractor
• Height gauge, where applicable
• Ensure components conform to approved drawings and tolerances.
• Identify and segregate defective components.
• Maintain inspection records where required.
• Ensure first-piece approval before batch production.
• Coordinate with the Quality and Production teams regarding dimensional issues.

4. Sheet Metal Knowledge

Candidate should have basic knowledge of:
• MS / CRCA / GI / SS sheet materials.
• Different sheet thicknesses.
• Sheet-metal cutting and bending processes.
• Bend allowance and bend deduction.
• K-factor – basic understanding.
• Flat pattern development.
• Press brake tooling.
• Laser cutting parameters.
• Material nesting and scrap reduction.
• Basic fabrication practices.

5. Machine Maintenance
• Perform routine machine cleaning and basic preventive maintenance.
• Maintain cleanliness around the machine.
• Check consumables, nozzles, tools and other accessories.
• Ensure proper lubrication and housekeeping as per machine requirements.
• Report abnormal machine noise, vibration, alarms or performance issues.
• Follow machine manufacturer's operating and safety procedures.

6. Safety Responsibilities
• Follow all factory and machine safety procedures.
• Use required PPE such as safety shoes, gloves, safety glasses and other protective equipment.
• Follow safe material loading/unloading practices.
• Ensure sheets are handled using appropriate lifting equipment when required.
• Do not operate machines without proper authorization.
• Follow electrical and machine isolation procedures during maintenance.
• Maintain a clean and obstruction-free working area.

7. Educational Qualification

ITI – Fitter / Machinist / Turner / Sheet Metal preferred.

Diploma in Mechanical / Production Engineering will be an advantage.

8. Experience

2–5 years of relevant experience in:
• CNC Laser Cutting
• Fiber Laser Cutting
• CNC Press Brake
• Sheet Metal Fabrication
• Electrical Panel Enclosure Manufacturing

Experience with sheet-metal electrical panel manufacturing will be preferred.

9. Required Skills
• Ability to read engineering and fabrication drawings.
• Good knowledge of CNC machine operation.
• Basic knowledge of CNC programming and program selection.
• Knowledge of laser cutting and press brake machine settings.
• Good dimensional inspection skills.
• Ability to work with minimum supervision.
• Good attention to detail.
• Ability to meet production schedules.
• Good housekeeping and safety practices.

10. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
• Cutting and bending accuracy.
• Production output as per schedule.
• First-time-right component production.
• Minimum material wastage.
• Minimum rejection and rework.
• Proper machine operation and handling.
• Compliance with safety procedures.
• Machine and workplace housekeeping.
• Proper care of tools and machine equipment.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
